camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --Tag.1.Key demokey --Tag.1.Value demovalue --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Attaches labels to one or more ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instances
description_zh: 为一个或多个云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --tag Value=demovalue Key=demokey --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

fields.help_en:
The key of the label.

N specifies the sequence number of the label key. For example, Tag.1.Key specifies the key of the first label, and Tag.2.Key specifies the key of the second label.
If the label key does not exist, automatic creation of the key is performed
fields.help_zh:
标签的键。

N表示传入第几个标签的键。例如Tag.1.Key表示传入第一个标签的键；Tag.2.Key表示传入第二个标签的键。
如果标签的键不存在，则自动创建
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag.

N specifies the sequence number of the tag value. For example, Tag.1.Value specifies the value of the first tag, and Tag.2.Value specifies the value of the second tag
fields.help_zh:
标签的值。

N表示传入第几个标签的值。例如Tag.1.Value表示传入第一个标签的值；Tag.2.Value表示传入第二个标签的值
fields.name: value
